resources.string: Welcome to CometOTP
A powerful advanced two-factor authentication App for Android.
Let\'s Get Started

This wizard will guide you through the initial setup. Please pay attention and read carefully otherwise you could lose data! \n\nDon\'t worry, you can still change any of the options later in the Settings page.
To ensure the security of your accounts, CometOTP only stores them in encrypted data files. Here you can choose which method of encryption will be used.

The KeyStore is a system component of Android for securely storing cryptographic keys. The advantage of using this method is that the keys are stored separated from the data files of CometOTP and can be backed up by hardware cryptography (if your device supports it). However, as the keys are not stored with the CometOTP\'s data files, this method prevents the use of external backup solutions (like Titanium). Please Note: If you choose this method, you will have to rely on the internal backup functions provided by CometOTP. \n\nWarning: The KeyStore is known to cause problems on some custom ROMs (and a few stock ones as well). So, if you don\'t mind entering a Password/PIN every time you start CometOTP, then it is highly recommended to use the password-based encryption method instead of the Android KeyStore.

This method will encrypt your data with a key generated from a password or PIN. The main advantage here is that this will work with external backup solutions (like Titanium) and it is much less failure-prone than the KeyStore. However, you will have to enter your credentials every time you start CometOTP.
Here you can setup an authentication to lock CometOTP. Since you have chosen Android KeyStore as encryption method this is optional.
Here you can setup an authentication to lock CometOTP. Since you have chosen Password/PIN as encryption method you need to set either a password or a PIN in order to proceed.

Android sync is a feature built in to android used to back up app data to a 3rd party service (usually Google). Backups are always encrypted and inaccessible to 3rd parties without your master password. This requires use of Password encryption method.
